caption: The drawing depicts two views of a circular, ring-shaped ceramic vessel with a small neck and foot, arranged vertically on a plain, off-white background. The main, larger view in the center shows the vessel decorated with blue motifs, including heart-shaped patterns and floral or foliate designs, distributed around its body. There are the initials "M.S" inscribed near the top center of the vessel in blue lettering. The ceramic appears grayish with a speckled texture, and the blue decorations are distributed evenly. Above the main drawing, there is a smaller inset in the top left corner, presenting another view of a similar or the same vessel, also circular with a hollow center, but decorated with stylized blue birds and foliage motifs around the ring. Both objects have a small, narrowed neck at the top and a rounded, stable foot at the base. The overall composition is clean, with ample negative space surrounding the objects.
title: Ring Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
